title: AISwap-X
tagline: Cross chain swaps with intents using natural language and a novel OFA model for instant swaps.
description:
AISwap-X is a cross-chain swap protocol that allows users to swap tokens across multiple chains almost instantly by using intents based on natural language.

Users can simply write their intent and AISwap will craft a transaction that is sent to bidders that can submit bids to fill the order. This process is a order flow auction that will be fully permission-less and secured by UMA and its Optimistic Oracle.
how_its_made:
The user interface is simple, it allow users (swappers) to express their intent using natural language and AISwap with the help of OpenAI and Langchain will turn that into a transaction.

Once the transaction is made, the transaction is sent to a permission-less pool where bidders and swappers interact. Bidders have a limited time to submit bids to fill the order, this process is a order flow auction, where the winner will have to guarantee the fulfilment of the order.

Thanks to this permisionless architecture, cross chain swaps are almost instantaneous.

Once the bidder fulfils its intent (send tokens to the swapper), he registers in the UMA's optimistic oracle data asserter contract, where in case he hasn't performed his intent, he can be disputed.

This process is fully optimistic thanks to UMA and its robust security guarantees.
